products.name: 8K HDMI Cable
products.summary: Available as HDMI 2.0 or HDMI 2.1 High Performance, 4K@60Hz to 4K@240Hz, up to 8K@60Hz, 18Gbps or 48Gbps bandwidth, HDR, synchronized audio & video, eARC, VRR support, ideal for monitors, TVs, projectors, gaming consoles and professional workstations.
products.description:
Connect your monitor, TV, projector, gaming console, or workstation with a reliable **HDMI display cable**, available in two performance levels depending on your setup.

Our **Standard HDMI 2.0 Cable** is designed for everyday office, entertainment, and monitor use, supporting **4K resolution at 60Hz** with up to 18Gbps bandwidth. It provides stable digital video and audio transmission through a single cable and is more than enough for most office monitors, TVs, projectors, streaming devices, and standard 60Hz displays.

If you are using one of our** high refresh rate gaming or performance monitors**, choose the High Performance HDMI 2.1 Cable instead. With bandwidth up to 48Gbps, it supports resolutions including **8K@60Hz and 4K@240Hz**, allowing compatible monitors to operate at much higher refresh rates. This is especially important for gaming, fast motion, high-frame-rate content, and professional setups where a basic HDMI cable can become the bottleneck.

The HDMI 2.1 variant also supports technologies such as Variable Refresh Rate (VRR), Quick Frame Transport (QFT), Auto Low Latency Mode, Dynamic HDR and eARC, providing smoother visuals, reduced display latency, and high-quality audio transmission for compatible devices.

**Important for monitor rentals**
A standard HDMI cable is already included with our monitor rentals, so you normally do not need to add another cable to your order.

This product is useful if you:
- Need an additional HDMI cable
- Want to purchase your own cable
- Need the HDMI 2.1 High Performance version to unlock higher refresh rates such as 120Hz, 144Hz, 165Hz, 180Hz, 240Hz or higher where supported by your monitor and computer

specs.label: VIDEO SUPPORT
